response.title: EEEAB's Mobs [Unofficial]
response.description: Unofficial port of EEEAB's Mobs - challenging bosses, mobs, structures and gear. Original mod by EEEAB.
response.body:
> ### Found a crash or a bug? Please report it here - do not blame the original mod!
>
> This is an unofficial port. Anything broken here is likely the port's fault, not EEEAB's. If something crashes or acts unexpectedly, please open an issue so it can be fixed.
>
> **When reporting, please include:**
> 1. Your **Minecraft version & mod loader** (Fabric / Forge / NeoForge)
> 2. What you were doing when it happened, plus the **crash report / log** if available.

**EEEAB's Mobs [Unofficial]** brings challenging boss encounters, dangerous new mobs, unique structures, and epic gear to your Minecraft world!

This mod expands combat and exploration by introducing custom-animated enemies with multi-phase boss fights, telegraphed attacks, and high-tier rewards.

### Key Features
* **Challenging Bosses & Mobs:** Encounter uniquely animated enemies equipped with custom spellcasting, special abilities, and multi-phase mechanics.
* **New Structures & Arenas:** Discover dangerous dungeons and battle arenas scattered throughout your world.
* **Unique Gear & Rewards:** Earn powerful weapons, armor, and specialized items by overcoming tough PvE encounters.
* **Skill-Based Combat:** Master attack patterns, time your dodges, and adapt your combat strategy to survive.

### How It Changes Gameplay
* **Action-RPG Exploration:** Turns standard world exploration into high-stakes dungeon crawling with rewarding boss fights.
* **End-Game PvE Progression:** Provides a meaningful combat challenge for players looking to test their gear beyond vanilla mobs.

***

*Disclaimer: Unofficial port licensed under LGPL-3.0. Sources have been modified from the original. All original concepts and assets belong to EEEAB. Original project: [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/eeeab-s-mobs).*
